title: Netanyahu calls UK 'Islamic Republic of Britain' over nuclear weapon remark
summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu referred to the United Kingdom as the "Islamic Republic of Britain" in a podcast interview. He also stated the UK would be the "first Islamic Republic to get a nuclear weapon." The remark drew criticism from a political rival who called it a "horrific diplomatic failure" and an attack on an international ally. The UK government responded to the comment.
summary_points: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called the UK the "Islamic Republic of Britain" in a podcast.
Netanyahu also stated the UK would be the "first Islamic Republic to get a nuclear weapon."
A political rival criticized Netanyahu for attacking an ally and causing a "horrific diplomatic failure."
The UK government responded to Netanyahu's remark.
